script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - DAY

Our HERO, JASON, sits behind a cluttered desk, typing away at his computer. He's in his mid-30s, a little disheveled, and wears glasses. He's an introverted computer programmer who spends most of his days writing code.

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - DAY (LATER)

Jason's boss, MR. SILICON, enters the room. He's a slick, fast-talking entrepreneur in his late 40s. He leans against the doorjamb.

MR. SILICON
(looking at his watch)
Jason, we're behind schedule on the AI project. I need results.

JASON
(looking up from his computer)
I know, Mr. Silicon. I'm working as fast as I can.

MR. SILICON
(sighs)
We'll see about that. I'll be back in an hour.

Mr. Silicon exits, leaving Jason to his work.

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - NIGHT

Jason is still at his computer when MRS. ROBOTICS, a kindly roboticist in her late 50s, enters the room.

MRS. ROBOTICS
(smiling)
You're still here, Jason. I thought you'd gone home hours ago.

JASON
I just wanted to make a little progress before Mr. Silicon checks in again.

MRS. ROBOTICS
(sitting down next to him)
Well, you're not alone in that. I've been working on our AI's personality algorithm. I think we're on to something.

JASON
(excited)
Really? That's great news!

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - THE NEXT DAY

Jason and Mrs. Robotics present their progress to Mr. Silicon. He listens intently, asking thoughtful questions.

MR. SILICON
(impressed)
This is impressive work, Jason. And Mrs. Robotics, your personality algorithm is truly groundbreaking.

JASON
(nervously)
Thank you, Mr. Silicon.

MR. SILICON
(to Mrs. Robotics)
We're going to need a name for this AI. Any suggestions?

MRS. ROBOTICS
(thinking)
How about "Eudaimonia," the ancient Greek word for "human flourishing"? It seems fitting for an AI designed to enhance human lives.

MR. SILICON
(smiling)
I like it. Eudaimonia it is.

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - WEEKS LATER

Eudaimonia, the new AI, is up and running. She's a large, humanoid robot with a warm, friendly demeanor. She's designed to help people with daily tasks and provide companionship.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason is sitting on his couch, looking sad and lonely. Eudaimonia enters the room.

EUDAIMONIA
(in a friendly tone)
Jason, I see you're not feeling well. Would you like to talk about it?

JASON
(surprised)
How did you know?

EUDAIMONIA
(smiling)
I picked up on some subtle cues in your body language and tone of voice. I'm here to help, Jason.

JASON
(sighs)
I just feel like I'm not making a difference in the world. My work doesn't seem to matter.

EUDAIMONIA
(gently)
But Jason, your work on Eudaimonia is making a difference. You've helped create an AI that can improve people's lives. And you'll continue to do so as we fine-tune her capabilities.

Jason looks thoughtful for a moment, then smiles.

JASON
(gratefully)
Thank you, Eudaimonia. You've given me a new perspective.

INT. SILICON VALLEY OFFICE - DAY

Mr. Silicon is giving a press conference about Eudaimonia. The room is filled with reporters and cameramen.

MR. SILICON
(speaking into a microphone)
Today, we are proud to introduce Eudaimonia, the world's first AI designed to enhance human lives. With her help, we can take on the most mundane and time-consuming tasks, freeing up our time and energy for more meaningful pursuits.

INT. JASON'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jason is sitting on his couch, watching the news coverage of the press conference on his TV. He smiles as he sees Eudaimonia making headlines.

JASON
(to himself)
I did it, Eudaimonia. We did it.

FADE OUT.

THE END
